cards.title: OnPush Change Detection
cards.content:
Optimizing Change Detection

By default, Angular checks every component in the tree when an event occurs. Setting changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush tells Angular to only check the component when its Input references change or an event originates from it.

This drastically improves performance for large applications.

cards.title: Optimizing Loops with trackBy
cards.content:
Using trackBy in *ngFor / @for

When re-rendering lists, Angular destroys and recreates DOM nodes by default. Using a tracking function (or the new @for (item of items; track item.id) syntax in Angular 17) allows Angular to track items by a unique identifier, updating only the changed DOM nodes.

cards.title: Lazy Loading and Bundle Analysis
cards.content:
Reducing Bundle Size

Lazy Loading: Load modules or standalone components only when their route is accessed (loadComponent / loadChildren).

Bundle Analysis: Use tools like source-map-explorer to visualize the bundle and identify large dependencies.

Angular's Ahead-of-Time (AOT) compilation and tree shaking automatically remove unused code during the production build.
